input: Find child care centers and preschools that run school-age summer camps for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville preschool school age summer camp child development center -site:care.com -site:winnie.com -site:activityhero.com

candidates.name: Childcare Network
candidates.note: School-age summer camps; local centers in Asheville, Arden and Fairview serve children through age 12.

candidates.name: Kiddie Academy of Asheville
candidates.note: CampVentures summer childcare includes a dedicated program for ages 5 and older, through age 12.

candidates.name: Eliada Homes
candidates.note: Full-day camp for rising first graders through age 12; junior volunteer opportunities for ages 13–16.

candidates.name: Hominy Baptist Church of Candler
candidates.note: Hominy Child Care runs summer camp for older children; the childcare ministry serves children through age 12.

candidates.name: Discovery Trails Learning Academy
candidates.note: School-age summer camps combine outdoor skills, science, arts and field trips; separate preschool camp also offered.

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: Camp Farmstead offers weekly outdoor summer sessions for ages 3–12, including school-age children.

candidates.name: KidQuest
candidates.note: Summer childcare for rising grades 1–6 includes swimming, hiking, field trips, art and STEM activities.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Licensed Camp Ruach serves children and teens; summer 2027 begins June 14 and welcomes all backgrounds.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Montessori
candidates.note: July 2026 weeklong camps served ages 3–6, including kindergarten-age children, with extended care available.

candidates.name: Forest School Foundation
candidates.note: Growing Wild Forest School summer camp serves ages 3–6, including kindergarten-age children, from 8:30 a.m.–1:30 p.m.
